articles.title: Bitcoin falls below $83,000 as dollar strength keeps markets on edge
articles.snippet: Bitcoin and gold hold steady as a firm dollar and rising bond yields weigh on sentiment, while IREN secures a multiyear cloud services deal with Anthropic.

articles.title: From GTA V on iPhone to Free Photoshop: This AI Tool Is Upending Software
articles.snippet: REA, a free toolkit that hands AI agents the keys to reverse engineering, crossed 100,000 GitHub stars in a week as AI-decompiled game mods, console ports, and Adobe clones flood the internet.

articles.title: Here’s a Way to Predict When AI Chatbots Will Turn Bad
articles.snippet: Physicists at George Washington University say a formula can estimate when an AI chatbot will flip from good answers to bad ones, and early tests on small models back it up.
